Ride Westside Post Happy Hour Casual Ride

Beaverton, OR · Social

Ride Westside Post Happy Hour Casual Ride is a social group ride in Beaverton, OR. It rolls second Monday and Fourth Monday of the month at 7:10 pm from BGs Food Cartel, western bike rack near the SW Rose Biggi Ave entrance.

Next ride Mon, Oct 12, 7:10 PM PDT every other week — confirm which week with the host

How we know

Ride Westside's site lists the Post-Bike Happy Hour Ride for Oct 12 and 26, 2026 and every second and fourth Monday into Sept 2027, and Shift's calendar lists it at 7 pm (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

When
Second Monday and Fourth Monday of the month, 7:10 pmSecond and fourth Monday of the month. Bike Happy Hour 4:30 to 7 pm, then find your bike at 7 and ride at 7:10 pm from BGs Food Cartel; back before 9.

BGs Food Cartel, western bike rack near the SW Rose Biggi Ave entrance, 4250 SW Rose Biggi Ave, Beaverton, OR 97005 Map ↗

For visitors

Dress for the weather and bring lights. Message Ride Westside on Instagram if you need anything. The happy hour before it is a meetup, not a ride.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:10 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual loop, 8 to 15 miles around Beaverton and Hillsboro.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ride Westside Post Happy Hour Casual Ride group ride

A casual evening loop after Ride Westside's twice-monthly Bike Happy Hour in Beaverton. The group rolls at 7:10 pm around Beaverton and Hillsboro and aims to finish before 9.
